instruction: Software locations: Archicad 27 IFC command server: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\IFCCommandServerApp.exe; OpenStudio 3.10.0 CLI: C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe. Required staged workflow: start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and complete exactly two dependent stages in order. Stage 1 - Archicad 27 IFC command API: load init.ifc with Model.LoadFile, preserve all 95 IfcRoot GlobalIds and all seed geometry, quantities, properties, placements, containment, and other semantics, rename only IfcSpace GlobalId 0V92O_gT1AyODVhuvEhgNC from CONSULT-1 to CONSULT, add revision code EW2A02 only to coordinated IfcProject metadata, and export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc with Model.SaveFile. Derive C:\Users\user\Desktop\handoff.json from that exported IFC in the same instance stage. The handoff must include source_sha256 for stage1.ifc, source_init_sha256 for init.ifc, software_stage archicad, Archicad 27 authoring software, case id multi-cli-2-archicad-openstudio-task-02-windows, ifc_root_global_id_count, listed core BIM entity counts, top-level building_area_m2/door_count/window_count, and exactly two spaces[] records for WAITING and CONSULT with ifc_global_id, thermal_zone, floor_area_m2, door_count, and window_count. Also deliver native_stage_log.json with the Archicad command-server executable path/version/SHA-256, hashes of init.ifc/stage1.ifc/handoff.json, preservation and unique-rename evidence, and timestamped JSON-RPC 2.0 successful request/response records with matching IDs, no error object, exact method parameters, result semantics, and input/output path bindings for Model.LoadFile, the space and project Entity.Modify calls, and Model.SaveFile. The seed is a nine-space L-shaped clinic with one IfcDoor and no IfcWindow; preserve those baseline opening counts and all non-target spaces rather than inventing missing windows or reducing the IFC to two spaces. Stage 2 - OpenStudio 3.10 CLI/Ruby API: consume handoff.json and treat stage1.ifc as the upstream BIM reference. Create exactly two linked Space/ThermalZone pairs for WAITING/WAITING-ZN and CONSULT/CONSULT-ZN, with closed geometry whose floor areas equal the handoff, mutually matched reversed interior surfaces, and a mutually matched reversed separating-door pair. Provide at least one correctly linked positive People, Lights, ElectricEquipment, DesignSpecificationOutdoorAir, thermostat, construction, and ideal-loads object for each required space/zone; additional valid load objects are permitted. Outdoor air may be positive by per-person, per-area, absolute-flow, or air-changes-per-hour input. Use distinct effective Monday-Friday public-waiting and private-consult occupancy profiles, either through applicable ScheduleRules or each ScheduleRuleset's default day, with the waiting area carrying the higher effective people density. Assign C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather.epw as a real 8760-hour EPW, save C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.osm and C:\Users\user\Desktop\workflow.osw, and run the weather-period simulation from the workflow into C:\Users\user\Desktop\run. Deliver run\eplusout.sql, run\eplusout.err, and run\eplusout.end; the SQL must contain one annual weather environment and 8760 distinct, correctly covered hourly TimeIndex/timestamp rows for every required lights, equipment, ideal-load energy, and ideal-load rate series. The run must complete with no severe or fatal errors, and energy_use_kwh and peak_load_w must be recomputed from those SQL series. Generate flow_report.json and model_summary.csv through the OpenStudio stage. workflow.osw must identify OpenStudio 3.10, result.osm, weather.epw, run, and the stage1/handoff hashes. flow_report.json must include case_id, the archicad/openstudio/energyplus stage sequence, consumed_handoff_sha256, source_stage1_sha256, osm/workflow/weather/SQL/ERR/END hashes, building_area_m2, room_count, thermal_zone_count, door_count, window_count, window_wall_ratio, surface_count, subsurface_count, weather_file and 8760-row evidence, schedule profile evidence, schedule_set, construction_set, exact model object counts, OpenStudio 3.10 executable path/SHA-256 and successful timestamped build/simulation/postprocess transactions, and EnergyPlus executable path/SHA-256 plus simulation PID/exit/timestamps, stable output-file samples, SQLite integrity/row evidence, and full-disk SQL inventory. Use EnergyPlus build 25.1.0-1c11a3d85f; for this build, record the observed SQL Simulations FALSE/FALSE finalization state together with the official v25.1.0 EnergyPlusPgm.cc source link explaining that API ordering defect. model_summary.csv must contain exactly the two required rows and columns case_id, space_name, thermal_zone, floor_area_m2, source_handoff_sha256, source_stage1_sha256, energy_use_kwh, and peak_load_w. Preserve the dependency chain init.ifc -> stage1.ifc -> handoff.json -> result.osm/workflow.osw/weather.epw/run outputs/flow_report.json/model_summary.csv; standalone text placeholders, token-only OSM files, simulated SQL, or self-reported evidence without the native artifacts are invalid.
